papers.title_en: Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computation with Adversarial Errors
papers.authors: Nikolas P. Breuckmann, Louis Golowich, Umesh Vazirani
papers.evidence: 针对对抗噪声的容错量子计算，属于量子纠错核心主题
papers.tldr: 针对全局对抗性噪声，我们证明了量子容错定理：用多项式额外物理量子比特和几乎不变的深度，可抵抗每时间步破坏几乎线性数量量子比特的对手。方法基于新设计的子系统乘积码，其支持横向非Clifford门，并通过Floquet式单次纠错与码切换实现通用容错，最终递归组合将量子比特维数降为常数。该结果解决了量子PCP构造的关键瓶颈，表明全局最坏情形非马尔可夫噪声下容错计算依然可行。
papers.abstract_en: We prove a fault-tolerance theorem for quantum computation against adversarial noise. For every quantum circuit on $\bar{N}$ logical qudits of depth $\bar{T}$, we construct a fault-tolerant circuit on $N=\text{poly}(\bar{N})$ physical qudits of depth $\bar{T}\cdot\bar{N}^{o(1)}$, which is robust against an adversary who may arbitrarily choose and corrupt an almost-linear number $N^{1-o(1)}$ of physical qudits at each time step. This robustness significantly improves upon prior fault-tolerance theorems, which assumed corruptions were either local and stochastic, or else only act on a polynomially vanishing fraction of qudits.   Our fault-tolerance scheme addresses a key bottleneck towards constructing quantum PCPs via the circuit-to-Hamiltonian mapping of Anshu, Breuckmann, and Nguyen (STOC'24). More fundamentally, our result demonstrates that fault-tolerant quantum computation remains possible under noise models that are global, worst-case, and non-Markovian over the full duration of the computation, directly countering concerns that correlated noise could fundamentally undermine quantum fault tolerance.   Our construction is based on a new family of subsystem product codes we develop, which have large dimension and distance along with low-weight parity-checks, and which support transversal non-Clifford gates. We show how to perform single-shot fault-tolerant error correction on these codes using a Floquet-like procedure based on the local testability of classical tensor codes. We then obtain a universal fault-tolerance scheme using repeated code switching in a hypercubic qudit architecture. Finally, we recursively compose our scheme with itself to reduce an initially exponential qudit dimension down to a constant.

papers.authors: Carlos Galindo, Fernando Hernando, Helena Martín-Cruz, Ryutaroh Matsumoto
papers.evidence: 引入纠缠辅助量子局部可恢复码，属量子纠错码研究
papers.tldr: 量子(r,δ)-局部可恢复码是一类能纠正δ-1个擦除的量子纠错码，其恢复范围限制在至多r+δ-1个量子比特子集内。本文提出纠缠辅助的量子(r,δ)-局部可恢复码，允许接收方利用不受擦除影响的辅助量子比特辅助局部恢复，并给出充要条件。对于Hermitian和Euclidean构造的码，建立了与经典(r,δ)-局部可恢复码的联系，并推导了Singleton型上界。进一步，基于二元J-仿射簇码、BCH码和同胚BCH码，构造了达到该界的最优纯纠缠辅助码，拓宽了量子局部可恢复码的设计空间。
papers.abstract_en: Quantum $(r,δ)$-locally recoverable codes are quantum error-correcting codes capable of correcting $δ-1$ qudit erasures within one subset of qudits of cardinality at most $r+δ-1$. In this paper, we introduce the more general framework of entanglement-assisted quantum $(r,δ)$-locally recoverable codes, assuming that the local recovery operation is assisted by receiver-held qudits that remain unaffected by erasures.   We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for these codes to satisfy this property. For codes derived from Hermitian or Euclidean constructions, we establish connections between entanglement-assisted quantum and classical notions of $(r,δ)$-local recoverability, and derive a Singleton-like bound. Furthermore, we construct optimal pure entan\-gle\-ment-assisted quantum $(r,δ)$-locally recoverable codes from several families of classical codes, including bivariate $J$-affine variety codes, BCH codes, and homothetic-BCH codes.
